mapper.select: select t1.*, s.subject_type as subjectType, s.id as subjectId, s.tenant_id as tenantId, s.merchant_id as merchantId, s.dept_id as deptId, (select ru.role_id from sys_role_user ru where ru.user_subject_id = s.id order by ru.id asc limit 1) as roleId, (select t2.name from sys_dept t2 where t2.id=s.dept_id) deptName from sys_user t1 left join sys_user_subject s on s.user_id = t1.id where t1.id = #{id}
mapper.update: update sys_user set password = #{newPassword} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from sys_user_subject where dept_id = #{value}
